english.title: Administer drug to woman to obtain intercourse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[applied or administered to]_
(B)_[caused to be taken by]_

**(..SPECIFY NAME..), a

(C)_[woman,]_
(D)_[girl,]_

a drug, matter or thing, namely **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE..), with intent to stupefy or overpower the said **(..SPECIFY NAME..) so as thereby to enable

(E)_[you]_
(F)_[another]_

to have sexual intercourse with her.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(1) of and Schedule 2 to the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
applied to/administered to/caused to be taken
by woman/girl
a drug/matter/thing
with intent
to stupefy/overpower her to enable self/another
to have sexual intercourse with her

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE - now see H5811

(i) The statutory requirement for corroboration has been repealed by the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
(ii) Where the victim is under the age of 16 years, reference to a 'woman' may be substituted by reference to a 'girl' (section 46 Sexual Offences Act 1956).
(iii) See also offence wordings: H1620 and H2002 for similar offences - administering poison with intent to injure / aggrieve / annoy. and H2003 - administering with intent to endanger life and H2410 - administering a drug with intent to commit indictable offence.
(iv) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

other.penalty:
Two years imprisonment.
